text_block_list.text:
—One day. Blast Onepiece came to me 
saying, “I want to overcome my fears.”

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
An anatomical model in Tachyon-senpai's 
room started glowing and collapsed... so I 
ran away without thinking! Ugh, I'm still 
trembling all over.
choice_data_list:
Maybe the medicine got on the model and 
made it glow...

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
"...Whenever I get scared, I instinctively 
run away. Even if my friends are nearby... 
all alone... I just take off running. I 
hate that about myself, though."

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
"Boo wants to protect them. I don't wanna 
run away anymore...! Please!! Lend Boo 
your strength!! I want you to train me so 
I can conquer my fear!!"

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
It looks like everyone is willing to 
help...
choice_data_list:
By the way... what kind of special 
training is it?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
I didn't know specifically... what I 
should do. So for now... I thought I'd 
just let them get used to it.

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
??? H-Has this thing even started? 
Everything's just like usual... and there 
are no ghosts. Something like this isn't 
scary at—

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
...Why is everyone... in the same 
classroom...? A-And besides...

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
I... I don't understand what everyone is 
saying...? C-Come on, guys... Explain it 
so Bu can understand—

Everyone in the classroom was staring at 
Blast Onepiece. Her eyes, completely 
devoid of emotion like an artificial 
doll's---

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text: U-Ugh... U-Uwaaaaaaaaahhhhh!!!!!

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Y-Yes... I'll try asking.

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
*sniff*... Wh-where did I end up all of a 
sudden? What is it this time...? Ugh, is 
it another terrifying thing like 
before...?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry... I didn't know when to hold 
back. This is the academy, but... well, if 
you could just think of the scenery as an 
illusion...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
This should be simple... I think. All we 
have to do is slip past that thing and go 
through the door over there.

text_block_list.name: Endlessly Weeping Something
text_block_list.text: Ugh, hic, sob, uuuugh...

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text: Sh-She's crying! Are you alright?!

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Pay it no mind. ...That thing is just a 
creature of that nature.
choice_data_list:
I don't think you need to think too deeply 
about it...

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
I-I see... Alright... ...*G-Gulp*. Just 
slip through. Just... slip... through.

text_block_list.name: Endlessly Weeping Something
text_block_list.text: AAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAHHHHHHHH!!!!!!!!

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text: WAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAA!!!!!

Trial after trial came crashing down upon 
us. We made our way through countless 
rooms, but the result was...

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
Uuuugh... Everything was terrifying. I 
couldn't win at all...! Buu totally gave 
in to fearrr!!

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
"...That is not the case at all. Right, 
Trainer?"
choice_data_list:
Even though you were scared, you saw it 
through.
It's okay to feel afraid, you know.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Yes. And besides... While running away, 
they grabbed both me and Trainer nearby 
and carried us to safety.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Besides... when you were running away, you 
took both my hand and the Trainer's, 
pulling us along with you...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
When people feel fear, they become 
cautious. To protect themselves and the 
ones they love. ...It isn't entirely a bad 
thing.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Fear is also a kind of defense 
mechanism... It is precisely because we 
sense danger that we try to run away.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Besides... even if I run away all on my 
own...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
I'm certain you will come back to help. 
You wouldn't just abandon them. ...Am I 
wrong?

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text: Cafe-senpai...

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text: Y-Yeah…… Yeah! I'd never abandon Buu!

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
Even if I get scared and reflexively run 
away... I will stop! And I will come back 
to save you!

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: ...Yes. I think that alone is plenty.

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
...Hehehe. Thanks, Cafe-senpai! Ah... are 
both of your arms okay? I kept grabbing 
onto you during it, didn't I?

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
I was so terrified, completely 
desperate... I ended up dragging you 
forcefully, too. I'm sorry.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
No, there's no need to apologize... 
Well... it seems you ended up bringing 
something else along with you, though...

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text: Huh?
—sO haPpy, tAkE mE aNYwheRe, eVErywHeRE.

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text: Waaaaaaaaah!?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
"...Fufu. It might be hard to get used to 
it."
